cover_letter:
Dear Orac team,

I'm writing to apply for the Web Solutions Analyst: CMS & Ecommerce role. What draws me to Orac is the combination of craft and digital ambition: walls as blank canvases, and web platforms that need to feel just as considered. I work where SEO, content, and web technology meet, and I enjoy turning messy technical puzzles into clear, stable solutions.

In my current freelance and junior digital marketing roles, I manage CMS content in WordPress (Elementor, Astra, Rank Math) and Shopify, build and maintain sites, and run technical SEO audits. I've set up structured data, improved site health scores, and documented processes so others can follow. I've also worked with ticketing and incident flows, tested updates before release, and used AI tools and Python to automate repetitive checks. At Knowledge Experts, I supported SharePoint-based digital workplace sites for large retail and logistics clients, which taught me how important clear communication and reliable systems are.

I'm comfortable as a second-line support point: requalifying tickets, troubleshooting with business teams and partners, and keeping communication flowing. I create user-friendly documentation in English and enjoy testing new features to make sure they're stable and ready. I'm eager to learn Orac's project management methods and grow with your digital and marketing teams.

I'm based in Zwijndrecht and available for flexible hours. I'd welcome the chance to discuss how my mix of CMS, ecommerce, and analytical skills can support Orac's digital transformation.

Kind regards,
Baver Ok
